pages.text: $(bold)Organ catalog$(0) - nine items, one per slot:$(li)$(4)Eyes Organ$(0) (eye) -> eye slot$(li)$(4)Heart Organ$(0) (heart) -> heart slot$(li)$(4)Lungs Organ$(0) (lungs) -> lungs slot$(li)$(4)Viscera Organ$(0) (viscera) -> viscera slot$(li)$(4)Kidneys Organ$(0) (kidneys) -> kidneys slot$(li)$(4)Left/Right Arm Organ$(0) (left_arm / right_arm) -> limb slots$(li)$(4)Left/Right Leg Organ$(0) (left_leg / right_leg) -> limb slots$(br2)The first five fill "organ" slots, the four limbs fill "limb" slots - the $(bold)slot type$(0) sets the rules for rejection and side effects.

pages.title: Bonuses & Grades
pages.text: $(bold)Default template bonuses$(0) (base values, before grade):$(li)Eyes: +0.5 attack$(li)Heart: +2 max health$(li)Lungs: +0.5 armor toughness$(li)Viscera: +0.5 luck$(li)Kidneys: +0.5 attack$(li)Each arm: +0.75 attack and +0.05 knockback resistance$(li)Each leg: +0.015 move speed$(br2)$(bold)Grade I-IV multipliers: 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2.0$(0) - higher grades give bigger bonuses but also $(4)higher starting rejection and faster rejection growth$(0): stronger organs are pickier about their host.

pages.title: One Pipeline, Three Machines
pages.text: $(li)1. $(l:akaishi:life_struct)Life Structuring Table$(/l): forge organs from gene sequences (always succeeds; integrity follows purity)$(li)2. $(l:akaishi:surgery)Surgery Chamber$(/l): implant or extract them (costs essence and life energy)$(li)3. $(l:akaishi:cultivator)Organ Cultivator$(/l): purify samples and upgrade organ grades$(br2)Organs also feed the $(l:akaishi:mother_altar)Altar of the Black Mother$(/l) as tributes; rejection control lives in $(l:akaishi:life_potions)Life Potions$(/l).
Reading order: samples make sequences -> Structuring Table forges organs -> Surgery Chamber implants -> Cultivator purifies and upgrades. Store fine organs in the Vaults; potions handle rejection.
